gates.description: Every content type must have a unique ID, URL template, and at least one required field
No direct draft-to-published transition is allowed — at minimum: draft → review → published
SEO title template must produce 50-60 characters; meta description 120-155 characters
Every image context must declare whether alt text is required — no silent defaults
Zero redirect loops (A→B→A), zero redirect chains, zero self-redirects in redirect manifest
Robots directive must be set explicitly per content type — never let search engines guess

anti_patterns.description: Creating a content type without a URL template — all content must be accessible at a defined URL
Using placeholder alt text (image1.jpg, TBD, alt text here) — fails accessibility audits
Setting redirects that chain through another redirect — always flatten A→B→C to A→C
Workflow states that no transition can reach — states with no entry path are bugs
Declaring a controlled vocabulary type with an empty tag list — it enforces nothing
Publishing stock or third-party media without license declaration — copyright liability is real

escalation_triggers: Duplicate slugs detected that break routing and canonical URL logic
Redirect loop detected that causes browser errors or crawl issues
Expired media license with no replacement plan
Publishing workflow bypassed — content going directly from draft to published
SEO metadata templates producing out-of-range values across many content types
Controlled vocabulary degrading into free-form tags creating synonym proliferation

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with content requirements and SEO strategy

output_certifications: Every content type has unique ID, URL template, and at least one required field
No direct draft-to-published transition in any workflow
SEO title template 50-60 chars; meta description 120-155 chars
Every image context declares whether alt text is required
Zero redirect loops, chains, or self-redirects in redirect manifest
Robots directives set explicitly per content type
